notes.title: Pocket Waifu Anniversary Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Can you believe it's been one year since Pocket Waifu Desktop Pet got released on Steam? Wow! Thank you so much everyone for taking care of Lil Silvy![/p][p]We've prepared a big update for you, with new activities, new cosmetics, and a whole lot of new stuff! [/p][h3][b]6 new outfits, 2 new hairstyles![/b][/h3][p]Silvervale debuted a new Swimsuit outfit this summer and it's now available in-game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/81e5112ac745b5113ab9d0d88fb534f6f1b36bcf.png"][/img][/p][p]We've also added the associated haircut, a pretty ponytail! Both of these can be found in the Loot Bag or very rarely in shops.[/p][p]Did you watch Silvervale's birthday concert live? She unveiled new hot & stylish outfits, which you can now also get in Pocket Waifu![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/0f284dbd828d247cb85b756e9b39fb9b655ed86e.png"][/img][/p][p]There's the Grudge Goth outfit with two styles (hood up or down), the gorgeous Pink Birthday Dress, Maple's colorful skirt fit, and the Racer outfit with its own hairstyle! Wow![/p][p]The Pink Birthday Dress can be purchased in the shop with real money, and the others can be found in Loot Bags or bought for in-game money.[/p][h3][b]New fun activity: Fetch[/b][/h3][p]We've received requests of adding more interactive activities so we're happy to introduce Fetch![/p][p]Grab and throw a stick for Lil Silvy to bring back to you with adorable animations![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/556be7389a245910c4e1442c3cee565bb86a0020.gif"][/img][/p][p]If you're lucky she can even grab it with her mouth or fight you when you try to get the stick back! No take, only throw!![/p][p][/p][h3][b]New fun activity: Slots[/b][/h3][p]Something else we've noticed is there aren't enough ways to spend your extreme wealth in-game, so we're adding something that should help: gambling![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/73cabb3a2e49010645cf05e32a0cd493ba3d4702.gif"][/img][/p][p]Watch Lil Silvy crank that machine and anxiously wait for the results... You could win big![/p][p]This activity gives a lot of Happiness to Lil Silvy but it might not be profitable money-wise...[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New items to buy: Scratch tickets[/b][/h3][p]We've added a new category of items you can purchase: Scratch-off tickets![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/dc8f9c458aa5d686a6059bd2f8beedae3425e10f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/04b1562d13a691e7163b70726894f2ab62b860e5.png"][/img][/p][p]You can buy one of each of the three tickets per day for a small amount of in-game money, and a chance of winning many times that amount![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/ce200d953ae83f7e20fcdeb28b0578a222afd1d9.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Better Loot bags[/b][/h3][p]Some of you are very unlucky when it comes to Loot Bags and have a very hard time getting your hands on Epic items, so this should help![/p][p]You're now able to combine ten Loot Bags into one Rare Loot Bag which will give only Rare or Epic items, and you can combine ten Rare Loot Bags into one Epic Loot Bag which will give a guaranteed Epic Item![/p][p]And the best part about these... is you can get [b]one of each[/b] just by playing the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/f3635240946276061c898d7308edceb9b177d762.png"][/img]The next 3 days you start the game you'll earn a reward for taking such good care of your Lil Silvy!![/p][p]Since it takes 100 Loot Bags to make 1 Epic Loot Bag and the Loot Bag has a 1% chance of containing an Epic Item, it's only a good tradeoff if you are not interested in Common or Rare items![/p][h3][b]Lil Silvy can get sick![/b][/h3][p]Whoops! You've overfed your wolfgirl and now she's puking everywhere![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/e6628500e087bfe45d54c53ae0ce1b5f1169097f.gif"][/img][/p][p]She'll get better shortly, but you can give her medicine to make her feel better fast!
There are three kinds of medicine with different prices and effects, and you'll need to clean every puddle of puke by hand, sowwy![/p][h3][b]Changelist[/b][/h3][p]Now, there are more changes than what's listed above, so here's a list of everything:[/p][list][*][p]You can now reach [b]Affection Level 12[/b]! Lil Silvy loves you so much![/p][/*][*][p]Added the [b]Fetch[/b] activity. It is accessible for everyone and grants 2 Happiness every time you throw Lil Silvy her toy![/p][/*][*][p]Added the [b]Slots[/b] activity. It is accessible only after reaching Level 12 Affection, makes Lil Silvy very happy, and causes your wallet to get emptied fast![/p][/*][*][p]Added 8 Epic items: [b]Summery Swimsuit, Pretty Ponytail, Grudge Goth fit (hood up), Grudge Goth fit (hood down), Birthday Pink Dress, Chai Skirt, Racing outfit, and Racing Ponytail[/b]. They can be found in the Loot Bags and rarely in the in-game shop, except for Birthday Pink Dress which must be bought with real money.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 [b]Scratch-off tickets[/b]: Safari Snap, Borgar Builder and Quick Maffs. You can purchase each of them for $15 everyday and try to win up to 10 millions! Wow![/p][/*][*][p]Loot Bags can now be combined into [b]Rare Loot Bags[/b] which can be combined into [b]Epic Loot Bags[/b]. Rare Loot Bags have a 90% chance of yielding one Rare item and 10% chance of yielding an Epic item. Epic Loot Bags produce [b]only Epic items[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]A [b]cool 3D animation[/b] is played when opening Loot Bags. This can be turned off in the settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Lil Silvy gets [b]sick[/b] when you give her too much food too many times. You'll need to give her [b]medicine[/b] or wait until she feels better.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]7 new [b]achievements[/b] have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed random selection of Epic shop items. Hopefully for real this time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed jumpscare on/off setting being reversed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Buy 100 boxes" buying only 10 boxes at a time.[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope you enjoy this update and you keep enjoying this game for years to come![/p][p]As usual, please let us know if you encounter any issues or bugs while playing![/p]

notes.title: Pocket Waifu Bunny Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/69df1429118e0097bcacd03593bfa2929e71dfb2.png[/img]

Hello everyone! We're happy to release a new update for the game, with some new activities and a whole lot of cosmetics!

[b]New activity: Easter crafting![/b]
It's time to put your creative skills to the test once again, this time on easter eggs and bunnies!
You can pick from multiple paint colors this time, and rotate the items to paint them on all sides!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/c15d7ba692653d2c7b9ac9ef88ee4c9a028a0106.gif[/img]
The custom patterns you draw can be saved, but only up to 10 at a time!

[b]New activity: Easter hunt[/b]
Those beautiful eggs and bunnies lil Silvy and you have lovingly crafted? It's time to look for them!
A bunch of bushes and rocks appear on the screen and lil Silvy will inspect them to try to find the delicious snacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/5f277b303233594f00af6521912400a43a78891d.gif[/img]
You can help her by clicking on the bushes (you can drag them around, too) and you'll get a piece of chocolate for each item she finds!

[b]New cosmetics: Bunny girl and Bunny PJ![/b]
Two very different vibes: fuzzy comfy pajamas, or sexy refined bunny girl outfit!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/f0505e2f875a7d987db10d6cedf78aca4f8fc7e4.png[/img]
That's a total of 4 new epic items here: bunny girl outfit, bunny girl ears, PJ with hood up and PJ with hood down!

[b]New currency and loot box![/b]
To make it easier to get the new items, we've put them all in a loot box of their own!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/6822048f439cab48feaddbf3cd93e9dbde827596.png[/img]
You'll need to craft it using the chocolate pieces you get from the easter hunting activity, but you can trade them with other players.
Some items will also be available for in-game money in the shop so keep your eyes peeled!

Here's a full list of all the new stuff:
[list]
[*] Added the [b]Easter Crafting[/b] activity. It generates money over time, and one chocolate treat every 10 minutes!
[*] Added the [b]Easter Hunt[/b] activity. It requires you to make some treats in the Easter Crafting activity, and when lil Silvy finds them it generates up to 10 [b]Chocolate Pieces[/b] per day!
[*] Added the Chocolate Pieces and [b]Easter Loot Box[/b]. Combine 10 chocolates to make one box, and open it to get a random item of the Easter collection!
[*] Added 5 new epic items: Bunny Girl Outfit, Bunny Girl Ears, Bunny PJ (hood up), Bunny PJ (hood down), and Super Comfy Bunny Combo!
[*] Added 34 other items, including multiple Tail and Feet options![/list]

Enjoy the new update, and as usual let us know in the Steam Discussions or on Discord if you encounter any bug!

notes.title: Pocket Waifu Valentines Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/266b24ec2f2897d9cff827f845d55470c2a50e1d.png[/img]

Hi everyone! How's 2025 treating you so far?
We've been working hard to give you new activities to do with Lil Silvy and add some quality-of-life features!

[b]New activity: Valentines Chocolates![/b]
Watch Lil Silvy bake some delicious chocolate treats just for you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/c928c06a25af7edc73d9901849e5a0a6e5f21edc.gif[/img]
Once the chocolate box is shown, you can left click on the chocolates to eat them! There's an achievement for eating 20 of them!
You can also right click and drag to rotate the box, but that could lead to the chocolates dropping out of the box! Oops! (there is also an achievement for that)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/8a965a29a481acb9d3912d3cc516c1f2b58b4b2c.gif[/img]
[b]New activity: Valentines Cards![/b]
Snip snip! I love you! Lil Silver is going to draw and cut cute valentine's day cards for you!
They come in multiple shapes and drawings, and with a random cheesy message on them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/95957666312b6b6b65b8328bd248bde9d938451e.gif[/img]
Oh, and did you know you can write your name on them or draw anything you'd like? And you can save the result on your computer! Cute!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/d634405d5ce311317e23c9e575e9a26741e66830.gif[/img]
[b]New cosmetics: Valentine's day set![/b]
Your waifu is so elegant! You can find three new stylish items in Loot Boxes: an Outfit, a Tail item, and a new Haircut!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/2f6fcc9e773fd8074f2a0692cedfd40b4a0565fa.png[/img]
The update also comes with some quality-of-life changes for the inventory, here's the full list of changes in an organized list:
[list]
[*] Added the [b]Valentines Chocolates activity[/b]. It generates money over time.
[*] Added the [b]Valentines Cards activity[/b]. It generates up to 2 petals per day.
[*] Added 3 new achievements related to the new activities.
[*] Added a menu in the activities panel specifically for seasonal activities. For now, it includes the Halloween activity and the Valentines ones, but more might be on the way!
[*] Added a set of 3 new Epic items: [b]Elegant Wrapped Hair Buns[/b], [b]Elegant Red Minidress[/b], and [b]Elegant Golden Tail Accessories[/b]! They can be acquired by opening Loot Boxes.
[*] It's now possible to [b]open 10 or 100 Loot Boxes at once[/b]. The UI has been updated and improved to accommodate for the large number of items!
[*] A "duplicate" icon is now shown on items you receive from a box but you already own.
[*] Items are now all [b]stacked[/b] in the inventory! And you can sort them by count, which makes getting rid of duplicates a breeze!
[*] An outline has been added to the "owned" icon in the inventory so it is properly visible even on winter items.
[*] Every player now has a different [b]shop rotation[/b]: we originally gave everyone the same rotation to get you guys to yell "WHOA GO TO THE SHOP NOW THAT ITEM YOU WANT IS HERE!!" at each other but we've changed plans according to your feedback!
[*] Moved the wallpapers & other saved pictures to the save folder, where it won't cause any permission issues.
[*] Fixed the Sakura Splash helmet missing textures.
[/list]
We've begun work on translating the game and the setup process might have broken some text here and there! Please be on the lookout for out-of-place or weirdly sized text and report them as well as any bug in the Steam forums or on Silvervale's discord!

notes.title: Pocket Waifu Cosmetics Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/8850f15f0a6a27041e5b50669aa09a44b4f215b6.png[/img]
Hi everyone! Do you want to spend all your (in-game) money on gambling with loot boxes and assemble adorable outfits for Lil Silver? You're in luck, Pocket Waifu version 1.1 "The Cosmetic Update" allows just that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/99b902a7ebec8007624666b78ba800a55513e984.gif[/img]

We've added a bunch of hats, shoes, glasses, and many more items you can use to customize your Lil Silver! You can assemble the perfect fit, trade items and petals with other players, sell them on the Steam Community Market, or simply collect them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/b207647b3560438b0419664d89533aaa1ba4bbfc.png[/img]

But that's not all! The update includes two new fun activities: popcorn and pumpkin carving! The former will have Lil Silver cutely munch on popcorn (and throw and fail to catch it) with dynamic lighting, while the latter will have her cutely stab a pumpkin and wear it as a hat! Oh, the pumpkin carving is available only during the Halloween season until the end of November, so don't wait!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124254/25f9f41acfdd8b5a779134bbc7c935ca231b789b.gif[/img]

Here's a more organized list of changes! As usual, please let us know in the Petal Pal discord server or in the Steam Discussions if you encounter any bug!

[b]NEW FEATURES:[/b][list]
[*]Added more than 50 cosmetic items which can be worn by Lil Silver!
[*]Added Sakura Petals which are acquired through playing (up to 5 per day) or scrapping items.
[*]Added Loot Boxes which can be opened for one random item (and sometimes free petals). They're acquired either by combining 10 Petals or bought with in-game money.
[*]Items and boxes can be traded with other players or sold on the community market! Petals can't be sold but they can be traded.
[*]Added a "supporter pack" duo of unique outfits which can be bought with real money. Micro-transactions might allow us to add Pocket Waifu cards, badges and emotes to Steam!
[*]Added a new activity: movie watching! Lil Silver eats popcorn with dynamic lighting based on what's happening your screen.
[*]Added a new activity: pumpkin carving! Lil Silver stabs a pumpkin until it looks silly! This activity is only available until the end of November and will award you with unique cosmetics!
[*]Added 9 new achievements!
[*][spoiler]Lil Silver can now jumpscare you![/spoiler][/list]

[b]CHANGES, IMPROVEMENTS & FIXES:[/b][list]
[*]Sleeping has less effect on Hunger and Fun (lil Silvy was getting almost not hungry at all when sleeping, that's no longer the case).
[*]The "Savings Account" upgrade caps at $10000 interest per day.
[*]A small in-game icon notifies you when Silvervale is streaming on Twitch!
[*]Added a local backup of save files which is used whenever the cloud-synced save file is missing or corrupted. We are deeply sorry for all the progress that some of you have lost before, please please let us know if this happens again![/list]

[b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b][list]
[*]You might need to replay through the tutorial after this update. Nothing's changed and it's mostly harmless.
[*]The inventory may take time to update items you've just received, or tell you you've received the same thing multiple times. We're working on fixing that.[/list]
